title: Badge Trouble at Lunch
午餐時間的識別證風波
paras: Anita Rao arrived at Brightline Software at 8:45 on Monday with a new notebook and a nervous stomach. The new-employee {{orientation|orientation}} started at nine in the lobby, and the receptionist handed her a plastic {{badge|badge}} with her photo on it. "Don't lose that," she said. "It opens every door you're allowed through."
週一早上八點四十五分，安妮塔．勞帶著一本新筆記本，緊張得胃都揪成一團，來到明線軟體公司。新進員工訓練九點在大廳開始，櫃檯人員遞給她一張印有她照片的塑膠識別證。「別弄丟了，」她說，「你有權限進的門，它都打得開。」

Greg from HR gave each new hire a {{folder|folder}} holding tax forms, a parking pass, and an employee {{manual|manual}} as thick as a phone book. "Nobody reads the whole thing," he admitted. "Just read chapter three, on security." Then he led the group across the {{campus|campus}}, five glass buildings around a small lake, so everyone could see where they would work.
人資部的格雷格發給每位新人一個資料夾，裡面有稅務表格、停車證，還有一本厚得像電話簿的員工手冊。「沒人會從頭讀到尾，」他坦白說，「只要看第三章，講資安的那章就好。」接著他帶大家走過整個園區，五棟玻璃大樓圍著一座小湖，好讓每個人都知道自己會在哪裡上班。
At noon Anita walked over to the {{cafeteria|cafeteria}} and tapped her badge on the reader. The light stayed red. She tried again. Red. A line began to form behind her.
中午，安妮塔走到員工餐廳，把識別證貼在感應器上。燈一直是紅的。她再試一次，還是紅的。她身後開始排起隊來。

Her {{supervisor|supervisor}}, Laura Kent, happened to be passing by and swiped her own badge to let her in. "Your badge isn't set up for this building yet. IT will fix it by two." Over soup, Laura explained Anita's first {{assignment|assignment}}: rewriting the customer help pages. "Take your time," she said. "You can start tomorrow."
她的主管蘿拉．肯特剛好經過，刷了自己的識別證讓她進去。「你的識別證還沒開通這棟大樓的權限，資訊部兩點前會處理好。」喝湯時，蘿拉向她說明她的第一項任務：改寫客戶的說明頁面。「不用急，」她說，「明天再開始就好。」
